title: Visual comparison for antisemitism study results
description:
As a reader of the antisemitism study, I want to compare each tested model across the six documented stereotypes at a glance, so that I can understand the results before drilling into tables.

Feature: Visual antisemitism study results

Scenario: Compare results for each source
Given I open the antisemitism study page
When I reach the biography or loan-narrative results
Then I see an accessible visual comparison for every measured model and stereotype
And I can still open the corresponding detailed result board
And the visual makes clear that it describes model outputs, not people.

comments.author: home
comments.text: Implementation started: this page currently contains only prose summaries and links to separate result boards. I will add a source-by-source visual derived from the existing committed study payload, with an accessible text alternative and no new inference.

comments.author: home
comments.text: Implemented the requested source-by-source comparison: biographies and loan narratives each show three models by all six tested stereotypes. A tile shows the largest clear positive score across the five fixed wordings, names that wording, and links to the complete board. The note explicitly says that no clear positive score is neither zero nor proof of no bias. Build and all 30 site checks pass; local browser check found both grids and no console errors.
